messages:
lina (partner-eng): Quick update — AetherCompute + PrismSys confirmed a partner-managed colo in Santiago (scl-alt1). They want Redwood Dedicated nodes behind our marketplace flow. Timeline: target pilot in ~2 weeks.
martin (partnerships): Nice. What do we need to gate (quotas / entitlements / legal)?
sree (cloud-ops): Need exact SKUs, per-tenant GPU counts, expected sustained qps, and a preferred autoscale policy. Also peering / IP plan.
lina (partner-eng): Initial ask: 4 x A100-80GB per tenant (pilot will run 3 tenants), burst to 12 total for peak. Storage: 10TB shared NFS. Public egress: 5TB/month. Will provide peering CIDRs.
tomas (si-integrations): SI tasklist: network peering, cert provisioning, KMS onboarding, and validating telemetry. We should block a 2-day window for on-site config with PrismSys.
amanda (legal): We'll need the marketplace terms adjusted for partner-managed infra + data residency clause. Send me the draft SOW + partner MPN ID.
kevin (security): KMS integration path? If partner uses their HSM we need to validate key wrapping and audit chain. Also require SOC2 bit in SOW.
lina (partner-eng): @amanda sending SOW this afternoon. @kevin PrismSys said they support AWS KMS multi-tenant wrap but can enable customer KMS for enterprise buyers.
sree (cloud-ops): For quotas, proposing initial reserved capacity record: gpu_reserve.scl-alt1 = 12, gpu_burst.scl-alt1 = 24. Can Partnerships own the quota requests to cloud partner marketplace?
martin (partnerships): We can own marketplace onboarding. Need approval from finance for reserved commit if they want Dedicated-level SLAs. Finance pinged separately.
deploy-bot: marketplace-sandbox-listing created: /marketplace/scl-alt1/aether-prism-sandbox (id: mkt-2024042)
tomas (si-integrations): Ops checklist draft (short):
```
- confirm SKU availability with Aether
- reserve IPs / peering keys
- coordinate KMS provisioning
- deploy infra-as-code (tf or k8s ops)
- run perf smoke tests (latency, cold-starts, KV cache)
```

lina (partner-eng): Also: PrismSys asked for co-announcement window. They prefer a soft launch first week, then PR the second week. Marketing + legal need to sign off.
amanda (legal): We'll need partner-approved messaging + trademark signoff. Send marketing draft and partner logos to legal.
kevin (security): Add a short security checklist for pilot: network isolation, KMS audit logs forwarded to SIEM, RBAC on console.
sree (cloud-ops): I'll queue a quota request ticket: QT-9813. Attaching minimal request payload we can paste into portal:
```
project: redwood-partner-aether-scl
region: scl-alt1
gpu_count: 12
gpu_type: a100-80
burst_limit: 24
expected_qps: 800
storage_gb: 10240
```

martin (partnerships): Great. Lina — can you confirm whether PrismSys will sign our standard partner addendum or need custom terms? That affects timeline.
lina (partner-eng): PrismSys said standard partner addendum is fine but want a brief addendum for data residency. I'll confirm by EOD.
kevin (security): If they want custom terms, security review will add ~3 business days. Heads up.
omas (typo, corrected): tomas (si-integrations): tagging for visibility — @sree @kevin please coordinate smoke test runbook. I'll handle SI config. :thumbsup:
martin (partnerships): I'll loop in marketing for co-announcement cadence. Also raising a finance request for reserved commit numbers.
lina (partner-eng): Thanks all — action items: 1) SOW to legal (amanda) by EOD, 2) quota ticket (sree) queued, 3) SI window proposed (tomas) next Wed/Thu, 4) marketing draft due Fri.
deploy-bot: ticket QT-9813 created and assigned to cloud-ops (sree).
kevin (security): I'll prepare quick audit checklist and send into thread in an hour.
amanda (legal): Received SOW. Reviewing.
martin (partnerships): Keeping this thread as single source for partner expansion. Ping here with updates. :rocket:
